description: Sets one bit in a flag byte and then decodes a stream in which a negative control byte repeats a value and a non-negative one copies literal bytes. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: unpack_signed_run_length_stream
description: Decodes a stream in which a negative control byte repeats a value and a non-negative one copies literal bytes, writing the output to the destination buffer. Its body is shared with its neighbours.

name: unpack_signed_run_length_stream
description: Decodes a stream in which a negative control byte repeats a value and a non-negative one copies literal bytes, writing the output to the destination buffer. Its body is shared with its neighbours.

name: unpack_signed_run_length_stream
description: Decodes a stream in which a negative control byte repeats a value and a non-negative one copies literal bytes, writing the output to the destination buffer. Its body is shared with its neighbours.

name: detect_packed_file_signature
description: Opens a file through the library, reads its first longword and, when it matches the XPKF or PP20 packer signature, closes the file and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns its input value unchanged.

name: close_packed_file_handle
description: Closes the file handle held in a global by calling the library function at offset minus 36 when one is set, then clears the handle to zero. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: open_resource_and_release_handle
description: When a global flag is clear, obtains a handle through a library call at offset minus 84, queries a value through offset minus 102, and releases the handle through offset minus 90. Its body is shared with its neighbour.

name: open_resource_and_release_handle
description: When a global flag is clear, obtains a handle through a library call at offset minus 84, queries a value through offset minus 102, and releases the handle through offset minus 90. Its body is shared with its neighbour.

name: open_packed_data_resource
description: Opens a resource through library calls at offsets minus 84 and minus 102, releases it at offset minus 90 when it is set, and uses the xpkmaster library function at offset minus 36 for packed data. It calls seven unnamed routines.

name: check_device_flags_and_init
description: Obtains a structure through a library call at offset minus 552 and tests three flag bits in its status byte, calling the library function at offset minus 888 when all of them are set. It returns a value that records the outcome.

name: check_device_flags_and_init
description: Obtains a structure through a library call at offset minus 552 and tests three flag bits in its status byte, calling the library function at offset minus 888 when all of them are set. The body is shared with a neighbour that does more setup.

name: open_graphics_library_and_check_flags
description: Opens the graphics library by name through the exec library, checks the same status flags on the structure it returns, and calls the library function at offset minus 888 when they are all set. The referenced text is graphics.library.

name: copy_structure_fields_and_call_library
description: Copies three fields from a structure into globals and, when a handle is set, calls the library function at offset minus 510 and then one at offset minus 708, storing the result in a global. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: open_workbench_screen_and_display
description: Sets up a display screen through intuition library calls, making the screen and rethinking the display, and copies display values before and after the calls. The facts list the Workbench text and several interrupt and DMA control registers as touched.

name: close_display_screen_and_restore_copper
description: Undoes the display setup by calling intuition and graphics library functions for the screen, then writes the copper list pointer registers and clears the stored screen handle when it is set. The facts list interrupt and DMA control registers as touched.

name: set_copper_list_and_enable_dma
description: Points the first copper list pointer register at a global block and writes a DMA control value with its enable bit set. Three unnamed routines call it, and it was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run.

name: copy_aligned_block_rows
description: Chooses a fast or slow path according to the size of the block and whether its source and destination pointers are word aligned, then copies the data. It is called by sixteen unnamed routines.

name: allocate_and_link_list_node
description: Allocates a new record through a helper, sets its flags and counters to defaults, and links it at the head of a global list while incrementing a count. It has four unnamed callers and was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run.

name: build_offset_and_shift_tables
description: Fills a table of 330 entries with multiples of 160, then fills a second table with byte and word values derived from a division and remainder by sixteen. It is called by nineteen unnamed routines.

name: build_offset_and_shift_tables
description: Fills a table of 330 entries with multiples of 160, then fills a second table with byte and word values derived from a division and remainder by sixteen. Its body is shared with its neighbour.

name: initialise_record_block_defaults
description: Writes sentinel values of minus one into a block of records and copies defaults taken from a state structure into them, then writes several counters to fixed offsets. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run and calls three unnamed routines.

name: map_state_index_to_value
description: Maps a state index of 0, 1 or 2 to 70, 30 or 0, and any other index to minus five, storing the result in a fixed field, then derives a second field from twice the index. Three unnamed routines call it.

name: load_table_entry_into_fields
description: Uses an index from a helper to look up a word in a global table and copies that value into several fixed locations, deriving other fields from it. It calls five unnamed routines.

name: check_memory_type_and_set_flag
description: Checks available memory through the exec library and tests the memory-type flags of a block, then sets a counter and a mode value according to the results. It calls four unnamed routines.

name: add_interrupt_server_with_masking
description: Disables all interrupts through the interrupt-enable register, calls the library function that adds an interrupt server, clears pending interrupt requests and re-enables a selected set of interrupts. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run.

name: test_rectangle_overlap
description: Compares an object's position and size fields against limits and against a second rectangle, using comparisons and sums to decide whether they overlap, and updates state when they do. Seven unnamed routines call it, and it calls two.

name: walk_and_update_record_list
description: Walks a linked list of records until a null pointer, reading each record's byte and word fields and updating its position and state. Five unnamed routines call it.

name: walk_and_update_record_list
description: Walks a linked list of records until a null pointer, reading each record's byte and word fields and updating its state. The routine is shared with a neighbour that has the same entry code.

name: rotate_and_accumulate_bit_words
description: Disables multitasking, calls the library function at offset minus 456, then runs a loop that rotates a 32-bit register by four bits per step and ORs its bits into an accumulator, using a count from a stored field. It calls twenty-six unnamed routines.

name: clear_field_and_call_routine
description: Clears a 16-bit field in a structure, stores a return address on the stack and calls one unnamed routine. The decompiler shows stack-based control flow, so only part of its behaviour is recovered.

name: remove_interrupt_server_and_reset_state
description: Permits multitasking, removes an interrupt server through the library function at offset minus 462, and resets a set of state words before calling 28 unnamed routines. The facts show the keyboard serial data register as touched.

name: compute_signed_offsets_table
description: Loops seventy-nine times, combining a byte value with a value from a helper and storing either a doubled or a negated result in an array entry. Three unnamed routines call it.

name: compute_signed_offsets_table
description: Loops seventy-nine times, combining a byte value with a value from a helper and storing either a doubled or a negated result in an array entry. Its body is shared with its neighbour.

name: compute_signed_offsets_table
description: Loops seventy-nine times, combining a byte value with a value from a helper and storing either a doubled or a negated result in an array entry. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: update_rolling_checksum_word
description: Adds a value and a carry from a field to a stored 16-bit word, rotates the sum left by one bit with wraparound and XORs the result into the stored value. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run and has one unnamed caller.

name: shift_history_slots_and_update
description: When a counter is positive, shifts a few stored words down one slot, writes new fixed values into the top slots and advances a counter, otherwise returning early. It was entered from outside the static flow and calls twenty unnamed routines.

name: reset_state_words_and_call_helpers
description: Calls three unnamed routines and then clears state words in the game structure before continuing into a shared block. The decompiled output is fragmentary, so this description covers only the visible calls and clears.

name: adjust_record_fields_from_arguments
description: Reads position and size fields from an argument record, adjusts them by a per-call value and writes the results back into a state block, calling three unnamed routines. Fourteen unnamed routines reference it.

name: clip_sprite_to_screen_rows
description: Clips a rectangle against screen boundaries, computing clipped row offsets with a multiplier of 160 and sign-based adjustments, then calls two unnamed routines to finish. Seven unnamed routines call it.

name: release_pending_record_slots
description: If a status flag or a word is set, calls a routine and then clears a slot pointer in a structure, setting the status byte of the record it referenced to five. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run.

name: clear_two_slot_pointers_with_status
description: Clears two slot pointers in a structure and sets the status byte of each referenced record to five, calling one unnamed routine. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: clear_large_state_buffer
description: Zeroes 5184 bytes of a state structure starting at a fixed offset, then sets a flag word to one. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run and has one unnamed caller.

name: write_slash_then_spaces
description: Writes a slash followed by two spaces into three consecutive positions of a global text location. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: write_space_slash_space
description: Writes a space, a slash and a space into three consecutive positions of a global text location. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: write_spaces_then_slash
description: Writes two spaces followed by a slash into three consecutive positions of a global text location. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: write_slash_then_spaces
description: Writes a slash followed by two spaces into three consecutive positions of a global text location. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: write_space_slash_space
description: Writes a space, a slash and a space into three consecutive positions of a global text location. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: write_spaces_then_slash
description: Writes two spaces followed by a slash into three consecutive positions of a global text location. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: process_keyboard_serial_state
description: Reads keyboard state bits from the CIA-based serial register, sets a short delay counter when a key bit is set and dispatches to routines for different key states. It calls twenty unnamed routines, and the decompiled body is long and partly truncated.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen words from one global block to another, then assigns values derived from register-held globals. Six unnamed routines call it.

name: copy_table_block_into_globals
description: Stores a looked-up value in a global, sets one table entry to fifty, and copies a block of bytes from a table into a global buffer. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run and calls two unnamed routines.

name: blank_table_entry_text_fields
description: Writes a space character into the second byte of each record in a pointer table, stopping at a null pointer, and sets a field to zero first. One unnamed routine calls it.

name: blank_table_entry_text_fields
description: Writes a space character into the second byte of each record in a pointer table, stopping at a null pointer. Its body is shared with its neighbour.

name: advance_table_index_to_next_entry
description: Repeatedly calls a helper until it finds a non-zero entry in a global table, copies that entry into a state field and advances the table index by four. Two unnamed routines call it, and it calls five unnamed routines.

name: clear_sixteen_words_and_init_table
description: Clears sixteen words of a global block, assigns values derived from register-held globals and initialises a table through two unnamed routines. It was entered from outside the static flow during the reference run and has one caller.

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen words from one global block to another and then assigns values derived from register-held globals. The entry is reached only as a gap in the static flow, so its caller is not known.

name: patch_text_control_codes
description: Scans a text string up to an end-of-text marker and replaces the byte following each backspace control code with a value taken from the arguments. Four unnamed routines call it.

name: return_stack_value_stub
description: Returns the value on the top of the stack without doing anything else. It is referenced through a pointer in data and has one caller.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the data and address register values unchanged. Eight unnamed routines call it.

name: render_text_entries_from_table
description: Writes a space into a global text location and walks a table of entries while each entry is non-negative, calling helper routines to write each entry. It is reached through a pointer in data and calls two unnamed routines.

name: store_arguments_and_render_entries
description: Stores its arguments in a state structure and writes text entries through a few helper calls. It is reached through a pointer in data and calls two or three unnamed routines.

name: render_text_entries_from_table
description: Writes a space into a global text location and walks a table of entries while each entry is non-negative, calling helper routines to write each entry. Its body is shared with a neighbouring entry point.

name: store_arguments_and_render_entries
description: Stores its arguments in a state structure and writes text entries through a few helper calls. Its body is shared with its neighbours, and it is reached through a pointer in data.

name: write_blank_status_text
description: Writes a space to a global text location, calls eight unnamed routines to update text and clears one display field, returning the result of the final call.

name: store_arguments_and_render_entries
description: Writes a space, calls three helpers and stores a word argument in a state field before further text output. It is reached only through a pointer in data.

name: store_arguments_and_render_entries
description: Calls three helpers and stores two arguments in a state structure before writing further text. It is reached only through a pointer in data.

name: store_arguments_and_render_entries
description: Stores its arguments in a state structure and makes two helper calls before writing text. It is reached only through a pointer in data.

name: store_arguments_and_render_entries
description: Stores its arguments in a state structure and makes two helper calls before writing text. It is reached only through a pointer in data.

name: render_formatted_text_block
description: Stores two arguments in state fields and writes a formatted text block through a long sequence of character writes and one helper call. Twenty-nine unnamed routines call it.

name: wait_for_keypress_result
description: Loops reading keyboard state bits from the serial register, returning zero when bit 0 is set or a particular code appears, and minus one when bit 1 or another code is seen. It calls four unnamed routines.

name: write_difficulty_label_text
description: Writes the difficulty label referenced by the text EASY MODE into a text buffer through two helper routines, using a value derived from its arguments. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: locate_menu_record_and_draw_label
description: Computes the address of a 34-byte record from an index argument and a stored multiplier, then draws the EASY MODE label at that location by calling three unnamed routines. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: call_two_routines_and_return_args
description: Calls two unnamed routines and passes its arguments through, using a few register-held values. One unnamed routine calls it.
